Sorry, and please take this as constructive criticism, but this is bad. Like really bad. needs a lot more work.

UI elements should never change shape. Ever. Your buttons are too big, the colors are way too bright and the contrast is too harsh, the text too small, and the animation is jarring. Way too many animations, in fact. Animations serve to hint to the user that the element is interactive and that's all. Adding unnecessary animations to every element is horrible design.

White drop shadows look terrible. You need to be using an alpha channel for the opacity instead of a color.

And lastly, animating the text box should NEVER be done. Text should stay in one place and not move around. You're also obstructing the markup buttons above the text box. And I don't know what the hell is going on with the Cancel button.

I'm sorry to be so blunt, but this is something you need to keep working on if you want to learn how to be a good designer.

Edit: Looking better! Keep working on the animations.
